name: Task Card
description: Layered task cards with colored priority bands, recessed dashed outlines, stacked avatars and soft shadows.
summary: A customizable task card with a tactile project board. The studio includes DevClub project planning and development tasks for 2026, individual card editing, priority colors, status badges, date and count controls, light/dark themes and responsive layouts.
highlights: Four colored priority bands with custom label and color overrides
Recessed surface, dashed inset outline and adjustable layered shadows
Stacked avatars with image fallbacks and an overflow badge
Status badges, comment/link/file counts and calendar-safe due dates
Per-card editing and a responsive two-column board example
Subtle GSAP hover and focus lift with reduced-motion support
anatomy: <article> (Task card with named heading and layered outer shadow)
<div> (Colored priority band behind the recessed body)

physics.description: A reversible, scoped tween lifts the card on hover or focus without changing its layout.

accessibility.aria: The heading names each card. Avatar fallbacks expose assignee names, counts have descriptive labels, and due dates use a time element.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Hover and focus motion is disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

keyboard.description: Focuses the optional title action and board controls.
Activates the optional title action and studio customization controls.

bestPractices: Supply an ISO calendar date for dueDate.
Keep descriptions concise; longer descriptions are clamped to two lines.
Provide meaningful names for avatar fallbacks.
Use onOpen to connect the title to task details.
Keep a short priority label and status for compact layouts.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional description, clamped to two lines.

props.name: priorityColor
props.description: Override the priority band with any CSS color.

props.name: assignees
props.description: Names and optional image URLs, with initial fallbacks.

props.name: maxAssignees
props.description: Maximum visible avatars; remaining people appear in an overflow badge.

props.name: dueDate
props.description: Optional ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), displayed as DD/MM/YYYY without time-zone shifts.

props.name: theme
props.description: Theme for surfaces, borders and metadata.

props.name: padding
props.description: Content and footer inset, clamped to 12–32 pixels.

props.name: hoverLift
props.description: Hover and keyboard-focus lift, from 0 to 10 pixels; 0 disables motion.

props.name: bandHeight
props.description: Minimum priority band height, clamped to 38–60 pixels. Longer labels wrap to two lines.

props.name: surfaceColor
props.description: Override the recessed card surface color.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Makes the title a keyboard-accessible open button.
